name: PACS010_CreDtTm_Date_Format_Invalid
description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm contains an invalid ISO 8601 datetime. Common errors: 'Z' suffix, milliseconds (.123), missing timezone offset.
errorMessage: GrpHdr/CreDtTm has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 (e.g. 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00). Never use 'Z' suffix or milliseconds.

name: PACS010_Character_Set_Usage
description: All text values must comply with the CBPR+ permitted character set. Standard fields: A-Z a-z 0-9 space /\-?:().,'+. Extended fields (Nm, Adr, RmtInf): additionally !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\]. Use < for < and > for >.
expression: all(re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9 /\-?:().,\'+]*$', str(v)) for k, v in DATA.items() if isinstance(v, str) and not k.endswith('@Ccy') and not k.endswith('@Tp') and not re.search(r'(IBAN|BIC|LEI|UETR|MsgId|BizMsgIdr|CreDtTm|IntrBkSttlmDt|Nm|AdrLine|StrtNm|TwnNm|Ustrd|AddtlInf)', k))
errorMessage: Character set used does not comply with CBPR+ UHB specifications. Only A-Z a-z 0-9 space and /\-?:().,\' are permitted in standard fields. Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields allow extended charset including !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\].
fix: Remove characters outside the CBPR+ permitted set. For Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields use the extended charset. Replace < with < and > with >.
